enterprise_5000_plus.name: Enterprise (5000+ employees)
enterprise_5000_plus.description: Larger organizations typically have more stakeholders and longer approval cycles, but greater resources for implementation.

large_1000_5000.name: Large (1000-5000 employees)
large_1000_5000.description: Large companies balance resources with organizational complexity.

midmarket_250_1000.name: Mid-market (250-1000 employees)
midmarket_250_1000.description: Mid-market companies often achieve faster time-to-value due to more agile decision-making.

smb_under_250.name: SMB (<250 employees)
smb_under_250.description: Small businesses can move quickly but may have resource constraints.

nascent.name: Nascent
nascent.description: Organizations just beginning their journey. Higher risk but also higher potential upside.

developing.name: Developing
developing.description: Organizations building foundational capabilities. Good balance of risk and opportunity.

mature.name: Mature
mature.description: Organizations with established practices. Faster adoption and higher likelihood of success.

advanced.name: Advanced
advanced.description: Industry leaders with sophisticated capabilities. Very high success rates but incremental improvements.

strategic_assessment.name: Strategic Assessment
strategic_assessment.description: Strategy-focused engagements that create roadmaps but don't directly implement changes.

implementation.name: Implementation
implementation.description: Hands-on implementation that directly delivers value through execution.

transformation.name: Transformation
transformation.description: Large-scale organizational change combining strategy and implementation.

optimization.name: Optimization
optimization.description: Improvements to existing capabilities with focused scope and clear metrics.

hybrid.name: Hybrid
hybrid.description: Combined approach mixing strategic guidance with targeted implementation.

adoption_risk.name: Adoption Risk
adoption_risk.description: Risk that end users will not adopt the solution effectively.

scope_creep.name: Scope Creep
scope_creep.description: Risk that project scope will expand beyond original boundaries.

resource_constraints.name: Resource Constraints
resource_constraints.description: Limited client resources (budget, people, time) may impact delivery.

market_changes.name: Market Changes
market_changes.description: External market factors may affect expected outcomes.

technology_risk.name: Technology Risk
technology_risk.description: Technical complexity or integration challenges may impact delivery.

stakeholder_alignment.name: Stakeholder Alignment
stakeholder_alignment.description: Misalignment among key stakeholders may delay or derail the project.
